messages:
Asha: hey team — stuck in SFO, flight delayed. I can't take the 23:30->07:30 primary tonight. Sorry for late notice :pensive: Can someone pick up primary or shadow? My scheduled overlap: 00:00-06:00 (primary). If no one can do full shift, even a deputy for the 02:30-04:00 window helps. runbook link? shift id: #oncall-2026-03-15

Ravi: I can take primary from 00:00-06:00. I have a standup at 03:00 but can shadow handoff to Jake 02:50->03:40. I won't be able to bridge between 03:00-03:30.

PagerBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: model-worker/predict serving — pager rate 4x baseline, errors rising. Severity: P2. Affected: api-gateway path /v1/generate. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/incidents/321 — pages started 23:47 UTC.

Marta: Runbook here: https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/model-worker — short steps: 1) check worker health, 2) roll recycle workers, 3) check KV cache tail. Quick commands:

```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-worker
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-worker
gcloud compute instances-groups managed resize --size=6 model-worker-group --zone=us-central1-a
```

Also check autoscaler logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/autoscaler/scale.log`.

Jake: I can cover 03:00-04:00 as deputy if Ravi needs the standup. Ping me to join bridge.

Asha: Thanks all. @oncall-rotation-bot please record handoff if Ravi agrees.

oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff recorded: Ravi primary 00:00-06:00; Jake deputy 02:50-03:40. Reminder: update rota and set alert forward to Ravi's phone. :white_check_mark: 

Ravi: I'll start with health checks + if pages >3 in 10m I'll scale up the worker group by 2. If latency stays high after scale, switch to fallback model variant: `model-worker:quantized-v2`.

Marta: Customer impact note: Product reports ~30% of requests getting 502 for customer "acme-corp" (paid). If we see continued errors, open a bridge and notify CS + AE. Threshold: 5 incidents in 15m => bridge.

Jake: If bridge comes up, I can take Scribe/notes and follow postmortem template.

Asha: Confirming handoff done — leaving my laptop on. Thanks everyone. :pray:
